acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

currentValue().notice: Returns the USDC value of the PAXG position. Never reverts (PR1 parity / I2). - paxgHeld == 0: returns 0 (no position open). - Price fresh (lastGoodPriceAt within maxStalenessSecs): use lastGoodPrice. - Price stale: use lastGoodPrice × (1 - staleHaircutBps / 10_000).   If lastGoodPrice == 0 (no swap ever executed): returns 0. Note: S2-H has no external oracle. "Staleness" here means the last atomic swap executed more than maxStalenessSecs ago — the live market price is unknown. Cost basis (totalDeployed) is NOT used — consistent with GoldAllocationAdapter PR1.

deploy(uint256).notice: Atomic USDC-to-PAXG swap. Called by the vault once per execution cycle.         The entire amount is swapped in one transaction — no state persists between call and return.

goldOracle().notice: Mandatory XAU/USD Chainlink oracle (K2 — address(0) reverts OracleRequired).         isPriceSane() uses the oracle's `updatedAt` heartbeat for the freshness check,         so a 3-day idle S2-H with a fresh oracle stays sane.         pokePrice() updates lastGoodPrice from the oracle.         On testnet, pass MockXauUsdAggregator.

isPriceSane().notice: Returns false when the XAU/USD oracle is stale or unhealthy (K2 update).         The oracle is now mandatory — the last-swap-age fallback has been removed.         Uses the oracle's `updatedAt` field for the freshness check, independent of         when the last atomic PAXG swap was executed. A 3-day idle S2-H adapter with a         fresh oracle heartbeat stays sane. Returns true when no position is open         (lastGoodPriceAt == 0 means no swap has been executed yet).

lastGoodPrice().notice: Last USDC-per-PAXG price recorded at swap execution (USDC units, 6 dec).         Equivalent to GoldAllocationAdapter.lastGoodPrice. Set on every deploy/recall.

lastGoodPriceAt().notice: Timestamp of the last executed swap (deploy or recall).

lastPaxgPricePerUsdc().notice: Last observed PAXG-per-USDC price (1e18-scaled, PAXG per 1e6 USDC).         Set to 0 before any swap; used as the reference floor on subsequent swaps.         This is a simple last-price oracle — not a TWAP. Sufficient for testnet.         Production: replace with a 30-min TWAP from a Uniswap V3 pool.

maxStalenessSecs().notice: Seconds after the last swap before isPriceSane() returns false.         Default: 1 day. Settable by owner. S2-H has no external oracle;         staleness is measured from the last executed trade.

minOutBps().notice: Minimum output as a fraction of expected PAXG out.         Default: 9900 = 99% (1% max slippage).

pokePrice().notice: Anyone may call to refresh lastGoodPrice from the oracle (J2 / PR1 parity).         Reads the mandatory XAU/USD oracle price (K2: oracle is always set).

protocolName().notice: Human-readable protocol identifier, e.g. "Compound V3" or "Curve 3pool".

recall(uint256).notice: Return PAXG to the swap router, receive USDC back for the vault.         Also atomic — full exit in one transaction.

setGoldOracle(address).notice: Owner updates the XAU/USD oracle (K2 — must be non-zero; reverts OracleRequired).         Use this to rotate the oracle feed without redeploying the adapter.

setMaxStalenessSecs(uint256).notice: Set the max staleness window (seconds, max MAX_STALENESS_SECS = 7 days).

setStaleHaircutBps(uint256).notice: Set the stale-price haircut (bps, max MAX_STALE_HAIRCUT_BPS = 2000).

staleHaircutBps().notice: Haircut applied to lastGoodPrice when price is stale (bps, default 500 = 5%).         Settable by owner, hard cap MAX_STALE_HAIRCUT_BPS.

vault().notice: Address of the vault that owns this adapter (receives recalled funds).
